name: 夢幻七域
english_description: A Taiwan-origin (BIG5-encoded) fork of the ES II/Annihilator lineage, self-dated in its own boot banner to Feb 7, 1999 ("夢幻七域<建立架構 Feb 7, 1999>其精神源自ES2 Mudlib架構，特此感謝Annihilator") -- master.lpc's header carries only the base "for ES II mudlib / original from Lil / rewritten by Annihilator (11/07/94)" chain, with none of the later "modified by Xiang for XKX"/"updated by Doing Lu for hell"/"yh2003" lines that mark this collection's other ES2-descended families, making it a more distant, independently-forked sibling of that mega-family rather than a member of any already-catalogued sub-branch. A large archive (~33,000 raw files, ~168MB) with two playable regions (world1/world2) authored by many different wizards, most prolifically "tmr" (an entire multi-zone questing area: batogiya_dtl, dead_forest, down_cave, duli_forest/duli_port/duli_village, mist_forest, whale_forest/whale_river, barbarian_island, beast_base, crush_bone, quanzhen). Porting applied this project's now-standard catalog fixes for this lineage family: log_error() had NO warning-vs-error distinction at all (the worse variant already seen in revive, not just naruto/zhyx's miscapitalized-check version) and broadcast every lazy-compile warning to whichever player triggered it; is_chinese() used the classic BIG5/GBK byte-range-plus-length-gate check (both fixed to a CJK Unified Ideographs codepoint check per this driver's Unicode-codepoint-indexed strings); check_legal_name()'s byte-calibrated length bound and its per-character sliding-window gate were halved/dropped to match its own "1 to 6 Chinese characters" error message; and master.lpc's valid_write() called load_object(SECURITY_D) unconditionally with no re-entrancy guard, the classic §7.1 stack-overflow/silent-failure risk, fixed with a loading flag. Two severe, driver-endangering bugs were unique to this archive's own simul_efun/daemon layer, not previously seen in this collection: adm/obj/master.lpc's preload() apply -- the function the driver calls once per file in the master's own epilog() preload list -- gated every single preload attempt behind file_size(file+".c")==-1, which after this project's standard .c->.lpc rename would have made EVERY preloaded daemon (securityd, virtuald, logind, chinesed, etc.) silently never load at all; and adm/simul_efun/object.lpc's new_ob() (the central NPC/item-spawning wrapper used by well over a hundred call sites, plus feature/skill.lpc, feature/spell.lpc, std/skill.lpc, std/char.lpc, std/room/bank.lpc, and several other daemons) had the identical hardcoded-\".c\"-suffix shape, which would have silently broken virtually all room/NPC population site-wide. Both were mechanically auto-fixed by convert_lib.sh's own literal-\".c\"-reference sed pass (the extension appears as its own standalone string literal in each case), confirmed by direct inspection before ever booting -- documented here because the failure mode (every preloaded daemon or every spawned NPC silently absent, zero compile errors) would otherwise be extremely difficult to diagnose from a live boot alone. Also found and fixed: a pre-existing (not conversion-introduced) authorial typo class -- a stray backslash immediately before a string's closing quote ("鐵蓋\");, "罡\"HIC"」", etc.) -- confirmed present byte-for-byte in the raw BIG5 source and not an artifact of transcoding, which corrupted ~30 individual item/skill/room files by swallowing the rest of each file into one unterminated string; and a genuine §7.25-class room-population robustness gap in adm/daemons/roomd.lpc's make_inventory()/reset_room(), which had no catch() around a spawned NPC/item's own create() and no graceful-skip path for a single-instance "objects" entry that fails to spawn (e.g. an NPC referencing a skill file the archive never shipped) -- either bug converted an isolated missing-content gap into the ENTIRE containing room failing to load; fixed by adding a catch() in make_inventory() and converting reset()'s fatal error() on a missing single-instance object into a graceful log-and-skip, matching the multi-instance branch's already-correct behavior. The single largest confirmed content gap (not fixed, per project policy against fabricating files): wizard "tmr"'s entire personal questing zone (275 NPC/item files across ~15 sub-areas) #includes a local convention header, npc.h, that was never shipped anywhere in this archive -- a genuine pre-existing upstream completeness gap, not a conversion artifact, confined to that one wizard's own content tree and not on the registration/starting-area path. With all of the above fixed, a brand-new character registers end-to-end with a real Chinese name into the actual starting room "朝天樓" (Chaotian Tower, an inn near the fictional "朝天湖"/Chaotian Lake), and look/score/quit and a full restore-path relogin all produce correct output; no live outbound network side effects were observed during boot or testing (dictd.lpc's hardcoded remote-dictionary IP and userid.lpc's ident-lookup socket both exist in the source but are unreachable from preload or the registration/gameplay path actually exercised, and dns_master/ftpd are already commented out of this archive's own adm/etc/preload).
